### Observed differences

- In the later window, A27 is executed in every trace: it appeared in about 95 of 200 traces before and in all 200 after, averaging about one occurrence per trace versus about 0.5 before. [OCC005]
- A27's companions stayed the same but its reach expanded: before, A27 co-occurred with A14, A15, A26, A28, A40, A45 and A46 in about 48 of 100 traces (always together, with A40, A14, A15 and A26 before A27, and A27 before A28, A45 and A46); in the later window each of these pairs co-occurs in all 200 traces with the same ordering. [REL016, REL019, REL025, REL028, REL031, REL032, REL033]
- A32 and A33 have nearly disappeared: each appeared in about 53 of 100 traces before and in only 2 and 1 traces after, and the two no longer appear together in any trace. [OCC006, OCC007, REL036]
- A02 is executed much less often: about 60 of 100 traces before versus about 24 in 100 after. Its remaining occurrences always appear alongside A27, A14 and A15, sit later in the trace (mean relative position about 0.20 versus 0.36), and among A02's observed outgoing transitions the share leading to A15 fell from about 94% to about 45%, with the rest now spread over many targets. [OCC001, REL002, REL003, REL006, POS001, DIR001]
- Routing into the A27 segment strengthened: A26's outgoing transitions now lead to A27 in about 99 of 100 cases (about 47 before), with the former A32/A33 shares gone, and A14's transitions to A02 fell from about 58% to about 12% while those to A15 rose to about 77%. [DIR005, DIR003]
- A04, A06 and A10 became more common, each rising from roughly 4–6 of 100 traces to about 20 in 100. [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004]
- Smaller sequence-distance shifts accompany these changes: the A26-to-A28 event distance is now mostly 2 positions (about 95 in 100, versus about 47 before), and A13-to-A14 distances shifted slightly earlier. [LAG011, LAG004]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that, in the later window, every case executes the flow segment containing A27 — entered from A40, A14, A15 or A26 and leading on to A28, A45 and A46 — while the alternative segment containing A32 and A33 is no longer executed, and A02 runs in far fewer cases, only within traces that also contain A27. [REL016, REL019, REL025, REL028, REL031, REL032, REL033, OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC001]

The placement of A27 is shown directly by relational evidence: co-occurrence with seven partners rose from about 48 in 100 traces to all 200 with a stable ordering, consistent with A26's rerouting onto A27, and the participation changes are large and directly measured (A27 from 95 to 200 traces, A32 from 107 to 2, A33 from 105 to 1, A02 from 119 to 48). The distinct differences — A27 becoming universal, A32/A33 disappearing, A02 shrinking, and A04/A06/A10 rising — clearly exceed the roughly one item expected by chance (about 0.93 of 186 units tested), and the many A02-pair relations reflect that single participation drop rather than independent confirmations. [REL016, REL019, REL025, REL028, REL031, REL032, REL033, DIR005, OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004]

The evidence cannot rule out that the two windows simply sample different mixes of pre-existing process variants rather than a changed structure; A32 and A33's absence means only that they were not observed later, their new successor profiles rest on 2 and 1 outgoing transitions and cannot be interpreted, and A04's rerouting rests on 10 versus 41 outgoing transitions. [OCC006, OCC007, DIR006, DIR007, DIR002]
